correctness.rationale: PASS: For every monic separable quintic h over algebraically closed char-3 field, the genus-two Cartier–Manin matrix from coefficients of (x-t)h has determinant ℋ(T,S)=AT²+BTS+CS², also covering infinity via s=1/t. Independent symbolic expansion modulo 3 verified h′G-(2x+a4)h=Ax²+Bx+C and Disc(ℋ)=Res(h,G), G=D^(3)h=x²+a4x+a3. If A=B=0, h factors as (x³+a2)G, contradicting separability. At root α of h, h′(α)G(α)=ℋ(α,1), so a repeated ℋ root must be one excluded collision; otherwise two distinct smooth zeros. At any smooth zero Hasse matrix has rank exactly 1, by nonzero b0=h(t) or bottom-left entry 1 at infinity, hence a-number 1. The two Frobenius ranks are explicitly realized by h=x⁵+x⁴+x³+x at t=±1. This is about the parameter line, not moduli-stack multiplicities. Independent algebraic resultant/Bezout check and finite F3 examples corroborate, not replace the universal proof.
